title: Day 2: a lighter evening outdoors, and door cards for the time of day
caption: After work on day 2 the outdoor places were too dark on a phone. The same dusk is now lifted (more sky light, a stronger low sun and fill, a brighter grade), so people and paths read; the lamps and lit windows stay warm. Day 1's evening is unchanged. The shut shops now show a card for the time of day: 準備中 in the morning, 本日休業 after work, the izakaya's 本日貸切 on its curtain and the onsen's boiler-repair notice. Each pair is before | after.

images.caption: Dorm courtyard, loaded straight into the evening, so it keeps its own dusk light and barely changes
